assertionResults.title: Public booking detail and guest booking detail reuse one booking-detail model

steps.action: Open /dev/booking-detail-comparison to look for a mocked authenticated comparison harness for the shared booking-detail model.
steps.expected: A deterministic side-by-side public/guest booking-detail comparison harness renders for one coherent fixture.
steps.observed: The route redirected to /auth/signin instead of rendering a comparison harness.

steps.action: Open /bookings/booking-1 on the live public surface.
steps.expected: Either an entitled public booking-detail surface renders or the route redirects with route-appropriate access behavior.

steps.action: Open /guest/bookings/booking-1 on the guest portal surface.
steps.expected: Either a mocked authenticated guest booking-detail surface renders for the same fixture or the guest route shows distinct route-appropriate access behavior.
steps.observed: The route redirected to the same sign-in URL as the public route, so no guest booking-detail surface was available for comparison.

consoleErrors: Failed to execute 'measure' on 'Performance': 'SignInPage' cannot have a negative time stamp.

assertionResults.issues: Blocked: the required user-surface comparison was not executable in this isolation boundary. The available dev comparison route redirected to sign-in, and both the public and guest booking-detail routes resolved to the same sign-in recovery target instead of exposing one coherent entitled fixture for side-by-side model comparison. Deterministic repo evidence exists at src/app/(public)/dev/booking-detail-comparison/page.tsx, but the actual user surface could not render it in the assigned session.

frictions.description: The documented dev comparison harness existed in the repo but was not reachable in the assigned browser session because it redirected to sign-in.
frictions.resolution: None within scope; captured redirect outcome and fell back to direct public/guest route comparison attempts.

frictions.description: All visited routes emitted the same SignInPage performance-measure console error, which added noise while checking for clean console output.
frictions.resolution: Recorded the recurring console error alongside screenshots and route outcomes.

blockers.description: No mocked authenticated portal harness was reachable for /guest/bookings/[bookingId], and the live public/guest detail routes both redirected to sign-in for booking-1, preventing the required public-vs-guest booking-detail model comparison for one coherent fixture.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Tried the repo-discovered /dev/booking-detail-comparison harness first, then direct /bookings/booking-1 and /guest/bookings/booking-1 navigation in the assigned browser session; all paths still redirected to sign-in.

summary: VAL-CROSS-003 is blocked in the real user surface: the intended comparison harness and both direct booking-detail routes redirected to sign-in, so shared booking-detail model reuse could not be visually confirmed for one coherent fixture.
